findings.detail: Root lifecycle notifications can still be inserted as descendants.
Installed Codex threadSource payload is not parsed.
Status updates overwrite explicit capabilities incorrectly.
Codex serverRequest approvals are not handled.
Child permission narrowing is not enforced for turn/start.
Nonterminal delayed events can regress lifecycle state.
Capacity/cursor accounting is not unique per discovery run.
Spawn prompts are not retained in the child contract.
Focused regressions for these cases are missing.
